description:
Pixel Grunge is an edit-centric visual aesthetic, gaining popularity from 2020 to 2023 during the pandemic era characterized by pixelated imagery, foggy forests, and monochrome/Cybercore filters. It is adjacent to E-Girl and Cyber Swag .

The main fashion varies through subgenres such as Fairy Grunge , Cyber Grunge , Alt Kid , along with the aesthetics such as Kidcore , Cottagecore , and Cryptidcore where they were often used for sped up/slowed down song visualizers.

visualDNA.colour: White, gray, black, or any color variation besides purple, blue or pink
